profile.headline: Software Developer Engineer II at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: I'm always excited by opportunities to contribute to my organization's growth and long-term vision, solving complex and ambiguous problems on both business and technical fronts, and leading projects to fruition. I enjoy identifying architectural and process deficiencies within my space and driving their improvement to remove bottlenecks for my team, which allows us to scale and focus on our business goals.
